title: Most pick errors start at *receiving*
subtitle: 5 stages, one control each. Errors travel downstream.

stages.name: Receiving and put-away
stages.desc: Match to the delivery note, check condition, scan into a set location

stages.name: Storage
stages.desc: Control lot, expiry and status. Count by trigger, not once a year

stages.name: Picking
stages.desc: Release waves by cutoff, scan to verify every pick

stages.name: Packing and shipping
stages.desc: Check the load, load by route and dock, post the goods issue

stages.name: Returns
stages.desc: Decide restock, rework or scrap, then update stock status

takeaway: Dock-to-stock time = put-away confirmed time minus unload time

author.name: Hammad Ulhaq
author.role: Head of Supply Chain · 20+ yrs FMCG & Beverages
